title: Document Game Mode scene video generation (v2.1)
description: Skill says: architecture.md:101-102 describes Game Mode with only v2.0 features (state machine, tactical combat, HUD, checkpoint restore) and lists routes /api/game, /api/game-assets (architecture.md:157); the Roleplay Mode bullet (architecture.md:96-97) mentions custom backgrounds but no video; the provider/image-gen list (architecture.md:164-169) has no Video Generation category. Silent on scene videos. Reality (2.1): first-class scene video generation shipped for Game Mode, Roleplay, AND Visual Novel galleries (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). It uses a dedicated Video Generation connection (chat.ts:471 gameVideoConnectionId, :489-490 sceneVideoConnectionId) separate from image gen; MP4s save to a scene-video media store and appear in the Gallery Videos tab. Providers per docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md: Google AI Studio (Gemini Omni gemini-omni-flash-preview / Veo veo-3.1-generate-preview), xAI Imagine (grok-imagine-video-1.5), OpenRouter Video (google/veo-3.1), Seedance 2.0 (seedance-2-0) - note the changelog's scene-video bullet only names Gemini Omni + xAI Imagine but the doc lists all four. Editable prompt template is game.video (renamed from game.omniVideo, CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Fixed; chat.ts:473-476 gameVideoPromptTemplateId/gameVideoPromptTemplates). Manual Gallery Video action + per-image Animate buttons, video previews with Copy prompt, and draggable/resizable pinned video overlays (types in game.ts:594-609 GameSceneVideoAspectRatio/GeneratedSceneVideo). Selected via Chat Settings -> Agents -> Scene Videos -> Video Connection, or the Game setup wizard. Fix: add a Scene Videos subsection to the Game Mode block in architecture.md (and note Roleplay/VN galleries also get it); add a Video Generation provider category to the providers list; cite docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md.

title: Document Game Mode turn storyboards (v2.1)
description: Skill says: architecture.md:101-102 Game Mode section is silent on storyboards; agents.md has no storyboard concept. Reality (2.1): Game Mode turn storyboards split a completed GM narration into 2-6 anchored keyframes (usually 4) via a Prompt Director, render keyframe media concurrently, follow the current story section in a draggable/resizable viewer, are reopenable from Gallery, and support off-by-default Automatic Storyboard Animations (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added; docs/STORYBOARD_ENGINE_GUIDE.md). Per-chat settings: gameStoryboardAutoIllustrationsEnabled and gameStoryboardAutoGenerationEnabled (chat.ts:477-480). Types live in packages/shared/src/types/game.ts:611-681 (GameStoryboardStatus, GameTurnStoryboard, GameTurnStoryboardKeyframe); persisted via packages/server/src/db/schema/game-storyboards.ts and packages/server/src/services/storage/game-storyboards.storage.ts. Keyframe images land in the Gallery Images tab; when animations are enabled each keyframe is also animated into an MP4 in the Videos tab. Manual 'Create storyboard' button in the Game Mode Gallery panel requires the Game Illustrator image connection and works even when auto storyboards are off. Fix: add a Turn Storyboards subsection under Game Mode in architecture.md; cite docs/STORYBOARD_ENGINE_GUIDE.md and the game.ts types.

title: Document per-chat Game Mode media prompt presets + built-ins (v2.1)
description: Skill says: architecture.md 'Preset' object (lines 50-51) covers only prompt presets (Universal Preset v12); no mention of media prompt presets. agents.md is silent. Reality (2.1): per-chat Game Mode media prompt presets with three separate selectors - Illustration Prompt, Animation Prompt, and Game Video Prompt (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). Backed by chat.ts fields gameStoryboardIllustrationPromptTemplateId (:481-482), gameStoryboardAnimationPromptTemplateId (:483-484), gameStoryboardPromptTemplates (:485-486) for storyboards, and gameVideoPromptTemplateId/gameVideoPromptTemplates (:473-476) for scene/storyboard video. Read-only built-ins: Still Keyframes (id still-keyframes), Comic Page (id comic-page-keyframes), Colored Manga (id colored-manga-keyframes), B&W Manga (id bw-manga-keyframes) - all in packages/shared/src/constants/game-storyboard-prompts.ts:85-113; plus Cinematic Scene Video (id cinematic-scene-video) in packages/shared/src/constants/game-video-prompts.ts:31-34. Users get chat-local editable copies (the *PromptTemplates AgentPromptTemplateOption[] arrays). Selectors live in Chat Settings -> Agents -> Storyboards (Illustration/Animation Prompt) and -> Scene Videos (Game Video Prompt), per docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md. Fix: add a 'Game Mode media prompt presets' subsection (architecture.md and/or agents.md) listing the three selectors, the five built-ins with ids, and the chat-local editable copies.

title: Document Game Illustrator dynamic-prompt toggle (v2.1)
description: Skill says: agents.md:77 documents the 'illustrator' agent (scene illustrations, default runInterval:5) and agents.md:76 the 'background' agent, but says nothing about a Game Illustrator LLM prompt-rewrite toggle; decision-guide.md is silent. Reality (2.1): an optional Game Illustrator toggle for 'Dynamic LLM Prompt Generation' lets the selected prompt model rewrite Game Mode NPC portrait, location background, and key-moment illustration prompts before image generation (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added, #3225). The per-chat setting key is gameImageDynamicPromptEnabled - 'When true, Game Mode asks the chat LLM to rewrite generated asset prompts before image generation' (packages/shared/src/types/chat.ts:250-251). Related keys: gameImageAutoGenerationEnabled (chat.ts:248-249, manual controls kept but stops auto visuals when false) and illustratorPromptConnectionId (chat.ts:238-239, optional per-chat LLM connection just for writing image prompts). UI: Chat Settings -> Agents -> Illustrator, enable 'Game Illustrator' (docs/STORYBOARD_ENGINE_GUIDE.md:27,70,136). Note this is distinct from the post-processing 'illustrator' agent. Fix: add a Game Illustrator note to agents.md's illustrator entry (or a Game Mode media subsection) citing gameImageDynamicPromptEnabled.

title: Document the /illustrate slash command (v2.1)
description: Skill says: no skill file documents slash commands at all (SKILL.md, architecture.md, agents.md, decision-guide.md are silent on /illustrate and on the /-command surface generally). Reality (2.1): /illustrate (alias /ill) added for Conversation, Roleplay, and Game chats to trigger the same illustration action as the Gallery Illustrate button without opening the Gallery (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). Defined in packages/client/src/lib/slash-commands.ts:1044-1073 - name 'illustrate', aliases ['ill'], usage '/illustrate', local:true, description 'Generate a gallery illustration for the current chat'. It calls ctx.illustrate() (guarded by useGalleryStore illustratingChatIds to prevent concurrent runs) with a 30-minute timeout (ILLUSTRATE_SLASH_TIMEOUT_MS = 1_800_000, slash-commands.ts:171). Wired into GameInput.tsx, ChatInput.tsx, ConversationInput.tsx. Fix: document /illustrate (and note it is one of the client slash commands parsed in slash-commands.ts) in architecture.md's Game Mode / features area or a slash-commands note; state availability = Conversation + Roleplay + Game.

title: Note Game Mode manual background override behavior (v2.1)
description: Skill says: agents.md:76 describes the 'background' agent as 'picks/generates the scene background image' with no note that a user's manual choice can win over the agent. Reality (2.1): a manually selected chat background now overrides automatic GM scene background selection until the user removes it (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Fixed, #3304 - 'Fixed Game Mode background selection from Settings so a manually selected chat background overrides automatic GM scene background selection until the user removes it'). This mirrors the v2.0 tracker field-lock 'manual pin survives generated updates' pattern. Fix: add one sentence to the background-agent entry (agents.md) or the Game Mode section noting a manually selected Game Mode background persists over automatic GM background selection until cleared.
